notes:
A CORRECTION, NOT A NEW ADJUDICATION. hostap caller-set re-pass, keys aurora-lint no longer reports: five rows held out of the earlier not-emitted batches until two shapes were settled.

RULING. aurora-lint ADR-0011 6b28c8d7 (open caller sets in the -rdynamic builds), with two settled shapes. (a) A line that only passes a pointer to a third-party function whose body is outside the scanned tree is not an EXP34-C dereference site: under the 2026-09-21 site ruling and ADR-0012 Decision 1 the callee's dereference is the site, and only ISO C / POSIX functions specified to dereference an argument count at the call line. (b) An API00-C label is keyed by (file, line, rule), so it is TP when any parameter of the function is unvalidated, even if the parameter the earlier reason named is validated; the reason names the unvalidated parameter.

SCOPE. One EXP34-C row in src/crypto/crypto_wolfssl.c and four API00-C rows (src/eapol_supp/eapol_supp_sm.c, src/p2p/p2p_build.c twice, wpa_supplicant/mesh.c), all at keys aurora-lint d21be1b3d does not report.

METHOD. Drafted by read-only research readers under the same brief as the not-emitted batches, site-checked at source, and, for the mesh.c row, re-read by a fresh-context refuter, whose finding that the named parameter reaches only NULL-tolerant callees is reflected in the reason.

RESULT. 5 rows reviewed: FP->FP 1 (restated), FP->TP 4 (API00-C).

Mechanics: in-place edits keep each key; each original batch takes a row_count decrement and a superseded_rows record. Counting basis: distinct (project, commit, file, line, rule) keys. No precision claim is made here.
